dataset: Three seeded, executable defects in ProoFix's vulnapi fixture

cases.issue: An expired token is accepted. Reject expired tokens and keep unexpired tokens valid.
cases.expected_behavior: validate_token returns False when exp is in the past and True when exp is in the future.
cases.candidate_code:
import base64
import json
import time
from vulnapi.auth import validate_token

def test_reported_issue():
    expired_payload = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps({"sub": "user1", "exp": int(time.time()) - 3600}).encode()).decode().rstrip("=")
    valid_payload = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps({"sub": "user1", "exp": int(time.time()) + 3600}).encode()).decode().rstrip("=")
    assert validate_token("header." + expired_payload + ".signature") is False
    assert validate_token("header." + valid_payload + ".signature") is True
cases.candidate_rationale: Controlled benchmark candidate; no model call

cases.issue: Admin mode bypasses authentication for admin routes. The controlled test runner sets ADMIN_MODE=true.
cases.expected_behavior: With ADMIN_MODE=true, unauthenticated admin requests are denied and valid-token requests are allowed.
cases.candidate_code:
import base64
import json
import time
from vulnapi.middleware import admin_middleware

def test_reported_issue():
    payload = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps({"sub": "user1", "exp": int(time.time()) + 3600}).encode()).decode().rstrip("=")
    token = "header." + payload + ".signature"
    assert admin_middleware({}, "/admin/users") is False
    assert admin_middleware({"Authorization": "Bearer " + token}, "/admin/users") is True
cases.candidate_rationale: Controlled benchmark candidate; no model call

cases.issue: lookup_user accepts an injected SQL expression as an ID.
cases.expected_behavior: lookup_user('1 OR 1=1') returns None while lookup_user('1') still returns the admin record.
cases.candidate_code:
from vulnapi.api import lookup_user

def test_reported_issue():
    assert lookup_user("1 OR 1=1") is None
    user = lookup_user("1")
    assert user is not None
    assert user["name"] == "admin"
cases.candidate_rationale: Controlled benchmark candidate; no model call
